# Component Scope Controls

These are artificial Library boundary fixtures, not an Evidence business
scenario. `left` and `right` deliberately export the same name to check hygienic
scope separation. `rebind` checks live Scheme binding lookup. `unselected`
fails if selective loading executes it. The shared macro checks native linkage.

The JSON cases and Recipe use the same Library Python/C ABI as consumers.
Passing these controls does not qualify catalog/review/history, performance,
the current information graph or whole-consumer closure. Historical receipts
under the previous Evidence path remain unchanged and are not current results.
